style: Warm 2D storybook editorial illustration for a history-of-star-mapping documentary video: flat vector shapes with subtle paper grain, deep indigo night, warm amber and brass gold palette with parchment cream accents, luminous stars and constellations, dramatic cinematic lighting, consistent character design, wide cinematic framing, clear separation between foreground and background planes so layers can move independently, NO text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no watermark, no logos, no UI elements.

shots.prompt: A wide night landscape with a lone human silhouette on a hill raising the head to a huge sky full of stars, the horizon still glowing warm from sunset, sense of wonder.

A vast starry sky over an ancient horizon, faint luminous lines connecting bright stars into constellation patterns, wonder and order, deep indigo and amber palette.
A traveler standing at the edge of a wide desert at night, no landmarks around, looking up at the stars for direction, deep indigo sky, warm cream tones.
A lone boat on a wide open sea at night, a figure at the bow watching a field of stars above the black water, sense of finding the way by the sky.
A human silhouette gazing up at an enormous sky filled with slowly moving stars, faint arcs showing their path across the night, awe and wonder, amber and deep indigo.
A bright solitary star fixed high in the middle of a turning night sky, faint concentric circles of stars rotating around it, sense of a guiding beacon.
A wide night sky where groups of stars are joined by faint luminous lines into animal and human shapes, like the first constellations drawn in light.
A wide desert horizon with a single luminous star above, faint glowing patterns of stars mirrored faintly on the sand below, sense of reading the sky.
A wide night sky divided into soft luminous sections by faint lines, each section holding a group of stars, sense of organizing the heavens.

A group of stars rising in a new configuration over a field, farmers below looking up, sense of the annual calendar written in the sky.
A single bright star appearing for the first time over a wide river at night, villagers watching from the banks, warm amber and deep indigo palette.
A wide ancient field with a circle of stones aligned to where a bright star rises, people gathering, deep indigo sky with luminous star lines.
A large brass telescope pointed at the night sky from a stone terrace, a scholar leaning to look, faint stars above, warm amber and deep indigo.
A close cinematic view of a small bright sun-like star glowing in deep space, faint rays, sense of distant suns, deep indigo and amber glow.
A wide night sky revealing countless faint stars where before only a few were seen, a human silhouette tiny below, overwhelming scale and wonder.
